polityNote: Islamic Republic of Mauritania throughout the scope (Tiris el Gharbia, held 1976-1979, lies outside both the scope and the MRT atoms). NE depicts the 13-unit layout of 1990-09-10 → 2014-11-25 (single Nouakchott wilaya). Corrected 2026-10-06: Dakhlet Nouadhibou and Inchiri end at the Chami decree (2013-05-06) and Trarza at the Benichab moughataa (2018-02), whose lines the ne-admin1 atoms do not carry. Areas measured 2026-10-06: before Chami, Dakhlet Nouadhibou was 22,300 km² and Inchiri 46,800 (Statoids/Toupet; the ne-admin1 atoms give 17,151 and 44,779); today Dakhlet Nouadhibou is 37,793 and Inchiri 31,582 (de.wikipedia; geoBoundaries MRT ADM2 2020 gives 37,551 and 30,712), and 71 % of the geoBoundaries Chami moughataa lies inside the ne-admin1 Inchiri atom. So the 2013 moughataa moved about 15,000 km² from Inchiri to Dakhlet Nouadhibou; the 2018 Benichab moughataa took about a quarter of its 15,079 km² from Trarza (24 % of it lies in the ne-admin1 Trarza atom).
